summary: Verified plan 'usuario puede Cancelar/Reprogramar/Eliminar cirugías'. Backend: new test file (8 tests) + updated 2 stale regression files (iter126/127 asserted usuario=403 on cancel/delete; now 200). 26/27 backend tests pass; only failure is a pre-existing edge case (re-cancel of an already-cancelled surgery is allowed and creates a second clone). Frontend (Playwright, desktop): usuario sees Ver/Cancelar/Eliminar in list; list-cancel with reschedule -> toast 'Cirugía cancelada y reagendada', original greyed (no action icons) and clone at 27/01 11:30 with same clinical data; detail footer shows Cerrar/Cancelar/Eliminar/Editar; detail-cancel without reschedule -> 'Cirugía cancelada', no new row; delete from detail and from list -> 'Cirugía eliminada', row gone (persisted after reload). Cancelled surgery detail hides Cancelar/Eliminar. Anestesia: 0 cancel/delete buttons in list and detail (only 'Cerrar'), API 403 on both. Superadmin: list buttons present, detail Cancelar/Eliminar present, detail-cancel with reschedule date only (time kept 09:00) works. All test data cleaned up.

minor.issue: No status guard: cancelling an already-cancelled surgery returns 200, overwrites cancellation_reason/rescheduled_to and creates ANOTHER clone (duplicate rescheduled surgery). UI hides the button for cancelled rows so only reachable via API/double-submit, but now exposed to more users (usuario). Suggest returning 400 if status=='cancelado'.
rescheduled_from_surgery_id is stored on clones but not in SurgeryResponse, so UI cannot link clone back to original.

issues: Cancelled rows only greyed out with eye icon shifted right (no 'Cancelada' badge) — status not explicit; consider a badge
Cancel/Delete confirm dialogs: Textarea motivo, 'Cancelar cirugía' and 'Eliminar' confirm buttons, and detail 'Editar' button lack data-testid (tested via role/text)
cancelForm not reset when user clicks 'Volver' — reopening cancel for another surgery keeps previous motivo/fecha

action_items: Add status guard in cancel_surgery (400 if already cancelado) to prevent duplicate clones
Add data-testid to cancel-reason textarea, confirm-cancel and confirm-delete buttons and detail Editar button
Reset cancelForm when cancel dialog closes
(Optional) show a 'Cancelada' badge on cancelled rows
critical_code_review_comments: Permission is role-name based (require_role ['superadmin','usuario']) while create/edit uses permission flag manage_sala_operaciones — inconsistent; custom roles cannot be granted cancel/delete without code change. Consider a 'cancel_delete_sala_operaciones' permission.
SalaOperaciones.js is very large (>1900 lines) — should be split (dialogs into components).
Login rate-limit (per-minute) caused many skips when running several test files back-to-back; rerun after ~60s passed.

success_rate.backend: 96% (26/27; failing test is pre-existing edge case)
